# Know Your Meme

> > An encyclopedia of internet culture documenting viral memes, trends, and online phenomena across TikTok, Twitter, Reddit, and other social platforms.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive database for understanding internet culture, providing detailed explanations of viral trends, catchphrases, image macros, and social media phenomena. The site tracks meme origins, evolution, and spread across platforms like TikTok, Twitter/X, Reddit, and YouTube.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Catchphrases and internet slang
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral meme explanations
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Dance memes and challenges
- Pop culture references
- Breaking Bad memes
- Nostalgia memes
- Mental health memes
- Hood culture and 90s references
- Looksmaxxing terminology
- Conspiracy theories
- Cat memes

## TikTok Trends & Dance Memes

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok with lip-dubs
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking cliche millennial burger restaurant aesthetics
